newsitem.title: CHINA: TABLE-Erdos interim net up 5.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Erdos interim net up 5.8 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures)
Net asset per share 3.55 yuan vs 2.45 yuan
Earnings per share 0.16 yuan vs 0.20 yuan
Company name: Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd, which is China's biggest cashmere producer.
Note: The results were contained in a company statement released by the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Friday.
The figures are unaudited, as Chinese securities rules do not require listed firms to have their interim results audited.
Trading in the company's A and B shares would be suspended on Monday morning and resume in the afternoon.
